messages:
emily: Quick heads-up — int4 q6b pre-rollout evaluation flagged a ~2.8% drop on our instruction-heavy prompts vs fp32. pattern looks like paraphrase duplication + tokenizer splits causing rerank instability. we should build a de-duped eval bank, add token-span fingerprints, and run a short canary. who can own the curation pipeline?

raj: I can own the clustering + fingerprinting. prefer semantic clustering over exact-hash first to keep rare intents. will output centroids for labeling.

emily: yes semantic-first. keep provenance tags (prod-sampler / qonboard-explore). target ~7.5k -> ~1.5k candidates.

raj: running with embed-v3 and these params:
```
python infra/cluster_prompts.py \
  --emb-model embed-v3 \
  --sim-threshold 0.80 \
  --min-cluster-size 1 \
  --max-reduce 6 \
  --save-provenance true \
  --out gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/178450/centroids.json
```
will tag cluster ids and centroid fingerprints.

derek: add normalization: unicode NFKC, lowercase, strip punctuation, and compute tokenizer-v2 token-span md5 for each prompt. i've seen q6b-int4 split some ligatures differently. include token-span-length and token-split-delta columns.

emily: good call. also filter out very long items: drop if char_length > 3000 or token_span > 2048. and drop if >60% stopword density.

maria: I can generate adversarials — 200 prompts with tricky whitespace, bidi unicode, and 50 code-snippet edgecases. I'll push them as adv-178450 subset.

raj: please add those to the centroid list as flagged clusters. will include adv tag in metadata.

olivia: label-ops here. queue can take 1600 candidates with consensus-3. we'll route rare intents to team-sentinel and paraphrase-heavy clusters to team-paraphrase. need rubric: intent / accuracy / safety / tokenization-issue flag. also want a one-line exemplar per intent.

aj: infra side — can reserve canary nodes: 2x A10 for q6b-int4 runs and a backup int8 build on standby. I'll allocate during the eval window. please give me exact ETA so I can pin nodes.

emily: timeline proposal: raj clustering + fingerprints (T+6h), label-ops consensus (T+48h), emily/derek run canary eval and delta analysis (T+72h). aim to finish within 3 days.

derek: I'll also create a small synthetic adversarial holdout (200) that stresses tokenization and whitespace. pushing to gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/178450/adv.json

label-bot: new job created: curation-consensus-178450 | size=1600 | consensus=3 | due=2026-04-03 | link=https://labelops/queues/178450

olivia: added rubric and exemplar CSV to job metadata. QC rules: agreement < 0.6 -> auto-escalate; adjudication budget = 8h.

raj: first pass clustering done: 7.6k -> 1.52k centroids. uploaded: gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/178450/centroids.v1.json (includes token_md5, token_len, provenance, adv_tag).

maria: adversarial sets uploaded and annotated: gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/178450/adv.v1.json. includes bidi and ZWJ cases.

aj: infra reserved. will hold nodes on 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC for 6 hours. fallback route configured to int8 via traffic policy redwood:canary->fallback:int8.

emily: after labels land we'll run squeeze test: run q6b-int4 and fp32 on canary set; metrics: top-1/top-5 accuracy delta, hallucination rate (LM-metric), and tokenization-mismatch failures. threshold: <1% top-1 regression and no critical hallucination surge. failing cases get annotated and added to a regression ticket.

derek: also capture per-token timing and KV cache stats so we can check if quantization changes attention behavior.

emily: final actions: raj attach centroid path here (done), olivia monitor labeling and post QC summary, maria confirm adv set (done), aj confirm infra (done). i'll kick the eval once labels publish. thanks all! :rocket!
